svg.title: UCP Platform Client - Multi-Merchant System Architecture
svg.text: UCP Platform Client — Multi-Merchant System Architecture
UCP platform/agent client · FastAPI + MCP (JSON-RPC) · official ucp_sdk models · merchant registry (merchants.json) · LLM-chosen categories · SQLite buyer profile · updated 2026-10-23
Client — Buyer / Frontend UI (ucp-frontend, separate repo)
chat · product cards with the store name · one cart card per store · checkout card + delivery details form · protocol log
Request bodies are validated by the official ucp_sdk pydantic models. Payment is not enabled: checkout stops at reviewing the details.
Agent — agent.py (the LLM decides, the code acts)
gpt-4.1 on the dentsu AI gateway (Azure OpenAI)
chat.completions with strict function tools · up to 6 tool rounds per message
Prompt and tools built from the registry
system prompt lists every store and the categories it sells
stores_for(categories) → registry.selling() → stores ranked by matching categories
search_catalog at each store in parallel · every product tagged with its store
carts: {merchant id → cart} · one checkout open at a time (checkout_store)
buyer and address shared across stores · signals kept in memory only
_market_context(): currency, country, language, region, postcode from the profile
_profile_buyer() pre-fills a new checkout · shipping country overrides the profile's
MCP transport — call_mcp(merchant, tool, args) · one request pattern for every store
catalog | cart | checkout, plus context and signals
UCP business errors stay UCP responses
log_exchange(): store, tool, timing → protocol log
A store that fails a call is reported as a notice; results from the other stores still come back.
FastAPI lifespan — startup (runs once at boot)
stores fetch our agent profile at
A store that fails discovery or speaks another UCP version is marked unavailable and skipped; the other stores keep working.
public_url → client.py :7000, so stores can read our UCP-Agent profile
listed in merchants.json · each store owns its own cart, checkout and payment
home decoration, rugs, furniture, dining room sets, papasan chairs,
outdoor living, indoor styling, accessories, seasons, holidays, birthdays
furniture, sofas, sectionals, bedroom sets, dining sets, mattresses
"sofa" → furniture + sofas → Furniture City ranked first, then Pier 1
www host registered: allbirds.com redirects, and UCP forbids following it
car care, car cleaning, car detailing, car accessories,
car interior, car exterior, car parts
search_catalog · lookup_catalog · get_product · create / get / update / cancel_cart
create / get / update / complete / cancel_checkout · get_order
market: country · preferred_currency · language · region · postal_code
Created at startup by init_db(). One shared profile per running instance (POC).
Read on every catalog, cart and checkout call; written only through PATCH /api/profile.
Request signals (IP address, user agent) are never stored.
